f1_transfer_and_cold_reproduce_the_seale.why_it_can_fail: adding arms would have perturbed the existing ones if any RNG stream were shared; each arm draws its own default_rng

f2_frozen_prior_is_immutable_within_each.why_it_can_fail: the prior must not change after it is frozen or while target contexts are scored

f3_causal_prefix_uses_only_prior_cases.why_it_can_fail: the prefix mass must increase by exactly 24 only after each case is scored

f4_prefix_differs_from_the_original_with.why_it_can_fail: if the two histograms ever differ by more than the current case's own counts, then one of them is carrying something the other is not and the pair no longer isolates current-case contamination

f5_frozen_prior_puts_mass_on_every_exten.why_it_can_fail: a prior with zeros cannot reach 4,320 of the 4,608 configurations
